method.attachment: Evidence is attached to basin ontology identifiers and variable keys, not map coordinates.
method.comparison: Each evidence entry stores the reported literature quantity, the project metric used for comparison, linked-basin summary statistics, and a risk note when definitions or denominators differ.
method.denominatorWarning: Project water-demand deficit and groundwater values use effective WaterGAP grid cells after small-value masking; glacier storage is normalized by glacier-covered area. Literature values using total basin area or total regional volume must be interpreted through these denominators.
method.limitation: Most references are regional rather than basin-specific. They validate order of magnitude, sign, and spatial ranking; they do not imply exact equality.
